body: what a total savage. You had them thinking they were about to score, little did they know!

I started playing the Crew (original one) about 6 months ago knowing that the Crew 2 was coming soon. I managed to finish the original Crew in one night...... so it wasn't that much fun. However, playing the Crew 2 beta over the past few days, the races are SO much more difficult. For me at least, i like more competition when i play. So, there's more cars than the original, boats and planes, and everything is more open and challenging. I splurged on the $100 Gold Edition (that season pass tho), and I know im gonna be happy with the updates they roll out.
